summary: Backend unlike flow works correctly (3/3 pytest passing). Frontend is COMPLETELY BROKEN — /app/frontend/src/components/FeedCard.js has a syntax error at line 260 (orphaned garbage after the component's closing `}` on line 259). Webpack fails to compile; the app renders only the red 'Compiled with problems' overlay. No frontend e2e testing was possible.

ui_bugs.issue: SYNTAX ERROR — file is corrupted. The component function ends at line 258 (`);\n}` on lines 258–259), but lines 260–276 contain orphaned JSX fragments (`5,255,0.45)" color="rgba(255,255,255,0.45)" />`, an extra `</button>) : (`, and a duplicate red like-button block). Babel throws: 'Missing semicolon. (260:10)'. Webpack compilation fails; entire app is unusable.

The intended gray/disabled conditional like-button (per spec: 'If Liked, then the like button should go gray, just for that video') is MISSING from the active render path. The still-live like button at lines 248–255 is ALWAYS the red enabled variant — there is no `item.prior_action === 'like'` ternary around it. The orphaned dead code on lines 261–271 appears to be the ternary's `else` branch (red button) — the gray branch was never written, and the ternary head was never wired in. Even after fixing the syntax error, the gray-disabled state will not appear.

action_items: URGENT: Repair /app/frontend/src/components/FeedCard.js — delete the orphaned lines 260–276 that trail the closing `}` on line 259.
Wire the like-button ternary so it renders a GRAY DISABLED button when `item.prior_action === 'like'` and the red enabled button otherwise (currently the red button is unconditionally rendered).
Once fixed, re-run the frontend e2e (like → pill visible + gray disabled button → scroll back → still persistent → tap Liked pill → toast 'Like removed' → red button restored, no auto-advance).

NOTE for future: the seeded session token `sttest_SUQD-bH3lyJJOBLw-llOftxhxupA_9nU` (user demo-00) had already EXPIRED (~3 hours before this run). I extended `expires_at` by 7 days in `user_sessions` so backend testing could proceed. If E2 seeded the token, the seed script should refresh its expiration on each iteration.

rca_of_the_issue: Root cause: A copy-paste / partial-replace edit left duplicated JSX below the FeedCard() component's closing `}` (line 259). The intended change (wrap the like button in a `item.prior_action === 'like' ? <gray disabled button /> : <red enabled button />` ternary) was only partly written — only the else-branch was pasted, and outside the JSX return. Result: (1) webpack fails to parse the file, (2) even if syntactically fixed, the still-live block at 244–255 renders the red button unconditionally, so the gray-disabled state never appears. Reproduction: navigate to the app URL — you get the CRA red error overlay 'Compiled with problems: SyntaxError: FeedCard.js: Missing semicolon (260:10)'. Mitigation: delete lines 260–276 and wrap lines 248–255 in the missing ternary that returns a disabled gray button when prior_action==='like'.
